name: large-graph-main-thread-phase-profiling-selection-audit
selectionRules: Prefer the phase with the highest main-thread total and maximum single-call duration.
Treat canvas-draw as inclusive of lazily evaluated semantic computeds and report an exclusive estimate by subtracting nested phases.
Do not select Worker or viewport culling from route-level elapsed time alone.
Keep backend build latency separate from PerformanceObserver main-thread long tasks.
Select exactly one minimal M3C-3 implementation and defer the rest.

selectionDecision.reason: At 5000 nodes, layout simulation accounts for about 99% of attributed main-thread phase cost and reaches 29481ms in one call, while raw Canvas drawing totals 948ms and semantic derivation totals about 1269ms.

selectedNextStage.name: worker-backed-bounded-force-layout-kernel
selectedNextStage.scope: Move force-layout computation off the UI thread and bound per-tick repulsion work deterministically; preserve graph facts, camera, interaction, layout persistence, dirty-frame lifecycle, and reduced-motion behavior.
